analysis.snapshotNote: Reads the last synced Cloudflare snapshot, not live state. Sync after changing CF config before reading this.
analysis.title: CDN analysis

dialog.accountDesc: Once connected, zones, DNS records, rules and edge certificates are synced in by the scheduled task.
dialog.syncNote: Saving does not sync immediately. Zone data is pulled by the DNS sync task, or you can trigger it once from the scheduled tasks page.

empty.reason: Usually the Cloudflare credential is not connected yet (System → Data sources), or it lacks permission to read zones. This does not mean you are not using a CDN — confirm the connection before concluding anything.
empty.title: No CDN sites retrieved

error.title: CDN sites could not be loaded

field.accountTagHint: The Cloudflare account identifier. Useful with multiple accounts; leave empty if you have one.
field.tokenHint: Prefer a read-only token (Zone:Read + DNS:Read). It is a credential in itself — keep it out of tickets.
field.vendorHint: Only the Cloudflare adapter is implemented. Other vendors can be saved but sync will refuse them — better to know now than to hit it later.
field.vendorRequired: Pick or create a vendor first

forensics.desc: Per-request timings and security events, queried live from Cloudflare. When the other side says “we sent it long ago, you received it late”, the edge receive time splits the total latency into two halves that nobody could see before.
forensics.minutesHint: Try 60 first to confirm data is available
forensics.notRunYet: Set the filters and press Query. This hits Cloudflare live and does not run automatically.
forensics.title: CDN live forensics

hint: Cloudflare zones: status, plan, name servers and SSL mode. The first hop when investigating a domain problem.
title: CDN sites

tokenCheck.desc: Probes exactly which permissions the token has. This queries Cloudflare live rather than the CMDB snapshot — so you can verify a permission change right after making it.
tokenCheck.noAccounts: No accounts returned. This does not mean everything is fine — check whether any CDN account is connected.
tokenCheck.noChecks: No checks returned. This does not mean everything passed.
tokenCheck.slow: Probing each account against Cloudflare — this can take tens of seconds. Please do not click repeatedly; every click is a real request.
tokenCheck.title: CDN token permission check

verdict.error: Request failed — not a permission issue; check the token and network first
verdict.no_permission: Missing permission — tick the item above in the CF console

vendor.none: No CDN vendor exists yet. Accounts hang off a vendor, so create one here first.

zonesPartiallyFailed: {{count}} zone(s) couldn't be read and are missing from this list — that is not the same as having no zones.
pickFieldsHint: Pick the fields you want and run the query again.
tokenCheckRealtimeNote: This result comes from probing Cloudflare live; it does not read the CMDB database. After the check passes, run a CDN account sync so the query endpoints reflect the new permissions.
